ValidationRule.description: Restrict the file types that can be uploaded to salesforce
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.tiff'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.tif'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.jpeg'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.jpg'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.gif'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.bmp'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.png'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.pdf'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.doc'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.docx'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.xls'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.xlsx'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.xlsb'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.ppt'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.pptx'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.msg'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.eml'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.rtf'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.txt'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.csv'), !CONTAINS( LOWER(PathOnClient) , '.zip'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This file has a file type which is not supported by CMOS. Please note it is not possible to load this file onto CMOS
